title: Kononenkogroup process
description: The method in stages on white: each opens with a centred two-line grotesk heading over a wide drawing frame, an optional big serif statement with an indented first line, then a 30px serif paragraph on one side of a 15-column grid with a tiny serif label pinned (sticky) beside it, and an optional tiny list. Lines rise from their masks; the drawings fade in.
notes: the drawing frames are media slots (the original draws sketches in WebGL)
CSS only: reveals are scroll-driven; the label pins with position: sticky
